speaker: Doctor
text: Welcome to your consultation. I am Dr. Agent. You are a neonate presenting with seizures and lethargy three days after birth; please know I will ask you a few specific questions to determine the cause. First, what were your mother's blood type and Rh factor, and was there any bleeding during delivery?

speaker: Patient
text: 1100-g (2-lb 7-oz) newborn, 31 weeks' gestation. The patient was born three days ago with a birth weight of 1100 g at 31 weeks' gestation. The antenatal period was complicated by chorioamnionitis. Apgar scores were 3 and 6 at 1 and 5 minutes, respectively. The patient has become increasingly lethargic over the past 18 hours and experienced a tonic seizure lasting for 25 seconds.

speaker: Doctor
text: Thank you for those details; the history of chorioamnionitis and low birth weight is significant. Given the seizures and lethargy, I need to evaluate for metabolic causes. REQUEST TEST: Serum glucose and electrolytes, calcium, magnesium, and ammonia levels. REQUEST TEST: Complete blood count and blood culture.
